ledger: 2026-08-07 v0.12.0 — THE AIR IS REAL: the sky is now computed from actual atmospheric physics — light scattered by real air molecules. Distant mountains fade into blue with distance, sunsets ignite a true twilight arch, all verified against a physics reference to 8 decimal places. 90/90 tests.

2026-08-07 v0.11.0 — THE WAR SHOOTS BACK: anti-aircraft guns track you and fire leaded bursts (red tracers). Hull damage, red-flash hits, shot down = respawn. Nevada's real satellite imagery also landed — all three fronts are photographic now. 65/65 tests.

2026-08-07 v0.10.0 — THE REAL EARTH: actual aerial photography draped over Alaska and the Marianas (sub-meter USGS source), plus laser-scan normal maps and baked ambient shadows on all three fronts. The fjords look like the real fjords now.
2026-08-07 v0.9.0 — THE AAA PASS BEGINS: rebuilt render pipeline — temporal anti-aliasing, HDR bloom (sun halo + water-glint sparkle), lens ghosts. 121fps with it all on. 51/51 tests.

2026-08-07 THE MANDATE — new goal: the most beautiful game possible in a browser, built for the most powerful Macs. An 8-agent research fleet mapped the ceiling; the AAA rebuild starts now, then three full 10%-better passes.

2026-08-07 v0.8.0 — TARGETS ON THE GROUND: 29 units across the three fronts (convoy + SAM site in Nevada, ships in the Alaska Sound, a carrier group off Saipan). Shoot them, they burn. Kills score on screen.

2026-08-07 v0.7.0 — THE GUN WORKS: 6000-rounds-a-minute cannon with honest ballistics (bullets slow down and drop like real ones), glowing tracers, dust where they hit the desert, engine + gun sound. 11/11 tests.
2026-08-06 v0.6.0 — YOU FLY: mouse steers the jet, W/S throttle, real physics, crash and respawn. The game became a game.
2026-08-06 v0.5.0 — the sea is real: waves that match each place — glassy fjords in Alaska, Pacific swell over the reef.
2026-08-06 v0.4.0 — the ground is real: actual US Geological Survey elevation data for Nevada, Alaska and the Marianas. Zero seams, verified by pixel measurement.
2026-08-06 v0.3.0 — a sky that knows the time: physically-computed daylight, the sun where it really is, stars at night.
2026-08-06 v0.1.0 — the engine boots: runs in any browser, simulation so precise two computers get identical results.
2026-08-06 day zero — plan approved: 21 phases, one F-22, three real battlefields.
